svg.title: Physical AI Operating System — one voice, three ways to act
svg.desc: Voice enters HAL realtime. Conversation returns directly as speech. Delegated music requests use music and audio skills for playback and volume, with HAL LED feedback on supported bodies. Delegated computer tasks use harness-use and a paired computer agent; the final result returns through OS to HAL for a short announcement. All routes remain readable without animation.
svg.text: One voice. A conversation, an action, a finished task.
Realtime handles the moment. Skills connect the brain to a body — and to your computer.

g.text: Get work done on your computer
“Ask my Blender agent to lift the planes.”
Mic input → music output · LED feedback on RGB bodies
Illustrated flows · timing compressed · not a latency benchmark
Computer progress stays in the UI; the final result is spoken.
